integrity: All-order finite identity follows from coefficient differentiation. Three eigenvalue/covariance scales and the near-saturation limit are analytic. Exact enumeration is cross-checking, not proof. Earlier work establishes the underlying Lah representation, marginal factorial moments and negative association; these are not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Uniform positive compositions and independent continuous labels; dense/sparse and saturation results are asymptotic, with no uniform transition-region error bounds; earlier generating functions may implicitly yield the evaluated cross moments.
title: Exact covariance geometry of block records in uniform compositions
